budget_note_and_correction.overshoot: The per-host cap (4) was exceeded: 6 requests were made to www.samsung.com, not 4. Root cause: the bounded-fetch helper script's per-host counter was re-initialized at the start of each of this stage's separate Python invocations (01_support_root.py, 02_search.py, 03_manuals_and_finder.py, 04_article_leaf_check.py) instead of being read back from the persisted run_state.json, so the 4-per-host cap was only enforced within a single script run, not cumulatively across all of them.
budget_note_and_correction.corrective_action: No further requests were made to www.samsung.com or any other host once this was identified. The overall stage-total cap (12) and host-count cap (3) were both respected (6 of 12 used, 1 of 3 hosts contacted). This is disclosed here rather than silently corrected after the fact.
